description.value: North Point Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and tasting room in Lower Lonsdale's Shipyards District in North Vancouver, founded by three North Shore locals inspired by West Coast cabin culture. The taproom pours a rotating roster of house-brewed beers spanning session lagers to high-ABV IPAs, alongside in-house pizza and snacks. An elevated loft with views of the North Shore and Downtown Vancouver is available for private events.
